Class SortDirectionConverter

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.jpa.spring.web.SortDirectionConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter<String, SortDirection>
public class SortDirectionConverter extends Object implements org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter<String, SortDirection>
Converts a request parameter into a SortDirection, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, so clients may send asc, DESC or Desc.

Spring's built-in enum conversion is case-sensitive, which rejects the lowercase values most clients send. In a Spring Boot application this converter is registered automatically by PagingWebAutoConfiguration. In a plain Spring MVC application, register it yourself:

@Configuration
public class WebConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
    @Override
    public void addFormatters(FormatterRegistry registry) {
        registry.addConverter(new SortDirectionConverter());
    }
}

A blank value converts to null, which a PageSpec treats as absent (ascending). Any other value that is not a direction is rejected with an IllegalArgumentException, which Spring MVC reports as 400 Bad Request.
